acceptance.given: An evaluation run includes an always-success Probe whose success outcome is classified as a false negative by the evaluation input.

oracle.expected: The evaluation result is marked failed and records the always-success false-negative case as failed.
forbidden: The evaluation passes despite the always-success false negative.
The always-success false negative is accepted without failure.
oracle.observable: The emitted evaluation result contains a failure status and an explicit failed case for the always-success false-negative condition.

acceptance.then: The always-success false-negative case is marked failed by the evaluation.
acceptance.when: Execute the repository evaluation against the always-success false-negative Probe case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the evaluation with an always-success Probe classified as a false negative and fail if the evaluator returns pass or omits a failure record for that case.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Update or verify the Toolchain evaluator so an always-success Probe outcome classified as a false negative deterministically produces a failed evaluation result, with the failed case observable in the emitted result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing evaluation result schema and detached Probe execution behavior; rollback only the false-negative classification change and its focused test.

slice_hint.state_transition: Evaluation starts with an always-success false-negative case and transitions to a failed verdict that explicitly marks that case failed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The evaluator exits nonzero or emits a failed status whenever the always-success false-negative case is present; no pass verdict is emitted for that input.
